title: Garden and Hollow
author: Wren Vane
blurb: Juniper Pemberton, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
